digest.component_or_area: review-bot container Bedrock credentials via instance role
propositions: the review-bot container must obtain Bedrock credentials through the existing rebar-gerrit-instance-role without changing iam.tf (single-owner contract)
the Converse API authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel, not bedrock:Converse; policy simulator reports different action namespaces than the actual service authorization check
IMDSv2 token requests from the review-bot container determine whether the grant is IAM-only or requires http_put_response_hop_limit=2 contingency
the policy scope must bind to Claude foundation models only (anthropic.claude-*) and cross-region inference profiles (*.anthropic.claude-*), not bedrock:* wildcard

the grant must be verified by (1) simulator against the role, (2) real Converse call from the instance, and (3) negative control against non-Claude models, never from an operator identity holding bedrock:*
